# Code Anchors: Issue Kind Classification

- `libs/delivery-config/src/issue-kind.ts` — the kind rule: per-mode marker resolution through the shared publishing resolver, the case-insensitive match, the named mode mismatch, and the initiative marker tested last.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/issue-kind.spec.ts` — coverage for each declared mode, the initiative kind and its ordering, and the label-only initiative under issue-type mode.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — sub-issue classification and the unplanned and withdrawn checks, reading markers through the shared kind rule.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.spec.ts` — coverage for each declared mode, the legacy either-marker read, the mismatch refusal, and the missing issue-type-name report (#520)
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.ts` — the epic check the design stage's import runs, and the refusal of an initiative on every path.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.spec.ts` — coverage for the story and record refusals and for the unmarked parentless issue that still resolves (#520)
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — where the initiative, epic, story and record marker keys and their built-in label defaults are declared
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the import stage whose epic refusal this decides
- `components/skills/nxs-landed-reference/SKILL.md` — the landed-work lanes' epic refusal, which reads the declared classification through this resolver rather than a hard-coded marker name (#549)
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/stub-parent.ts` — the filer's parent check, reading a parent's kind through this rule.
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-command.ts` — close reads an issue's kind through this rule and refuses an initiative.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/story-candidates.ts` — validates a pull request's story candidates through this rule.
